title: fix(app-shell): a view-tab switch starts the next view with the quick filters its own URL carries (objectui#11992)
body:
Fixes #11992

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The console object page handed `ListView` the `uf_FIELD` quick-filter selections through `initialUfSelections` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`. It was a `useState` initializer over `window.location.search`, so the page read the selections once per PAGE mount. A view-tab switch keeps the page mounted and remounts `ListView`, whose key is the object and the view. The remounted `UserFilters` then restored the FIRST view's selections from that captured value, while the new view's address bar carried no `uf_` param.

`initialUfSelections` is now read from the router's current location (`searchParams`) once per list identity. That identity is `listIdentityKey`: the same object and view that `listSeedRef` seeds the Filter panel, search and sort on (objectui#11915), and that `renderListView` keys the list on. The value is held in a ref per identity, so the list's own chip writes do not rebuild the list schema. The variable's name, its hand-off to `ListView` (`userFilterSelections={initialUfSelections}`) and the `renderListView` dependency list are unchanged. The diff stays in the `initialUfSelections` declaration, with no helper.

**Producer, measured:** this page, not `plugin-list`. `UserFilters` reads `initialSelections` only in its own `useState` initializer. It applies restored values to the query on mount and does not report them through `onSelectionsChange`. So the stale value handed to it was the whole carry-over, and nothing wrote it to the URL.

## The dispatch's hypotheses, measured

- **H1, the producer: holds.** The new pin file was run against the unfixed page at base `0bbb67b9a`. On `qa?uf_priority=urgent` followed by the `qb` tab, the list query on `qb` carried `["priority","=","urgent"]`. The reverse was broken as well: on `qb` followed by a link to `qa?uf_priority=urgent`, the list queried no filter, because the capture from the first mount held none. `UserFilters` (above) is not where the carry-over comes from.
- **H2, the fix: holds.** All six pins are green at `6eb2c9fac` (below).
- **H3, no write loop: holds.** A view switch makes exactly one router navigation, a PUSH to the bare `qb` path with an empty query string, and `window.history.length` grows by exactly one. That is the same at base, under the ablation, and with the fix: the pin is green in all three.
- **H4, bytes:** read from the budget bot after CI; reported on the card, not here.

## Pins

New file `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.ufViewSwitch-11992.test.tsx`, 6 tests. It renders this page, `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` with its tab bar and `plugin-list`'s `ListView` with its `UserFilters` for real, and reads the list query at the data source. The switch is a click on the tab bar's own `view-tab-qb` button. The router is a `BrowserRouter`, as in the console, so the page's location and `window.location` are one thing here as they are in production. Every URL reading in the harness asserts that they are equal. A `MemoryRouter` does not move `window.location`, and the measurement on objectui#11860 had to set it by hand for that reason.

1. CONTROL: a fresh mount on `qa?uf_priority=urgent` applies it: query, chip count and URL.
2. `qa?uf_priority=urgent` followed by the `qb` tab: no quick filter in the query, on the chip, or in the URL.
3. The reverse: `qb` followed by a link to `qa?uf_priority=urgent` restores the filter.
4. The reverse by Back: `qa?uf_priority=urgent`, then `qb`, then Back restores the filter.
5. objectui#11915's precedence is untouched: the view switched to still opens on its per-user cache (a Filter-panel condition), with no quick filter.
6. H3: the switch is one PUSH and one history entry, with nothing replaced.

## Ablation

The fix was committed first. Then `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode put the once-per-page-mount capture back verbatim (the `useState` initializer over `window.location.search`), under its restore trap. The test subject is imported from `src` directly (`./ObjectView`), so there is no `dist` leg.

- At `6eb2c9fac`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `912960d4f7a5` to `86e98c562fe0`. Predicted before the run: 4 failed and 2 passed, with the control and H3 green. Measured: `Tests  4 failed | 2 passed (6)`, with the red ones being pins 2, 3, 4 and 5. Restore: blob after restore equals blob at HEAD (`912960d4f7a5`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- The same ablation at the first commit `f3c33636f` measured the same `4 failed | 2 passed (6)`, with the same restore proof.

## Gates, all at `6eb2c9fac` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` after the last commit)

- The union, run from the repo root with `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` and passed as two invocations. It contains every test file that names `ObjectView`, `userFilter`, `uf_` or `listUrlState` (`git grep -l -E` over `*.test.ts` and `*.test.tsx`: 326 files), the new pin file, and the two scanners the dispatch named (`packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`).
  - app-shell, console and `scripts/__tests__` (137 files): `Test Files  137 passed (137)`, `Tests  1835 passed (1835)`.
  - every other package (191 files): `Test Files  191 passed (191)`, `Tests  4472 passed (4472)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), run after the dependency closure was built (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`, `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new test file.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)". `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: "No changeset declares a `major` bump."
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`. `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on both touched source files: 0 errors (warnings only, of the repo's existing `no-explicit-any` kind).

## Acceptance notes

- **Bound, a late-resolving view:** the saved views can arrive after the first render and move the active view without a navigation. If the user picked a chip on the first view before that, the next view starts with that chip, because the URL still carries it. The URL and the screen agree, which is the card's criterion. The Filter panel instead starts that view from the cache, through `ownListParamsRef`. Stripping the chip from the URL there would be a new write on that path, and none was added (H3).
- **Bound, one view:** a navigation that stays on the same view but carries other `uf_` params does not remount the list and is not re-read. This is the same once-per-identity bound as objectui#11915's seed.
- **Read from source only, not measured:** `InterfaceListPage.tsx` and `ObjectDataPage.tsx` keep the same mount-time capture over `window.location.search`. Whether either one remounts its list under a page that stays mounted was not measured. Carrier: none; noted, not filed.
- **Docs:** no README and no guide page describes the once-per-mount capture, so there is nothing to update under the docs-driven rule.
- **Declared overlap with PR objectui#11991:** this diff leaves the hand-off lines that PR edits untouched. A read-only trial merge of this head with its head `848fe53e5` (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) is clean, exit 0.
